boxes.title: Iqta & army: added detail
items: **Fawazil** had to go to the ==treasury==; some notes credit **Aibak** with introducing iqta
Balban also gave iqtas to officers and troopers
Alauddin: ==market control kept cash pay adequate==; tightened audit of muqtis
Firoz: nobles controlled recruitment, promotion, discipline
Ghiyasuddin: post improved with **runners and horsemen**; dak chowki = precursor of modern post
